# RAG Frameworks & Pipelines

- [RAGatouille](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/RAGatouille) - Specialized retrieval tool for RAG in LLM apps using ColBERT late-interaction for token-level matching, integrable with vector stores like FAISS for high-precision retrieval and reranking. - [RAGFlow](https://ragflow.io/) - Open-source RAG engine for LLM apps with deep document parsing, multi-granularity chunking, hybrid retrieval integrating vector stores (e.g., Elasticsearch), and visual workflow builder.
